summary: Advanced Energy Industries completed a $1.15bn private offering of 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, including full exercise of a $150M greenshoe. Net proceeds of ~$1.128bn were used partly to repurchase $438.3M of existing 2.50% Convertible Notes due 2028 via cash (~$442.4M) and ~1.98M shares, plus pay $69M for capped call transactions. The new notes are non-interest bearing, convertible at terms detailed in the indenture, with optional redemption by the company after May 2029 if stock is 130% of conversion price. This is a liability management / capital return event optimizing the company's capital structure. Watch for potential dilution from conversion or further note repurchases.
